summary.text: John Potucek is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 13 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
He previously served in the House from 2014 to 2016, representing Rockingham 6.

paragraphs.text: John Potucek served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 6 from 2014 to 2016, and Ballotpedia lists his current House tenure as beginning in 2018.
Its campaign contribution history shows general-election wins in Rockingham 6 in 2018 and 2020 and in Rockingham 13 in 2024.
He was assigned to the Commerce and Consumer Affairs Committee, serving as vice chair in the 2021-2022 and 2025-2026 sessions.
